label: просп. Ушакова (Незалежності), 49 — ЦУМ (Центральний універсальний магазин), Херсон
notes: Soviet-modernist 1960s-70s department store, NOT a 1950s stucco ensemble: pale silicate-brick block with full-height glazed window groups between brick piers and a flat roof with a railing and the roof sign «ЦУМ». Edge 1 (37 m, faces east) is the Ushakova Avenue face; ring is clockwise so pattern is written left (south) to right (north), i.e. reverse of edge order. Edges 2-3 (south face, 31 m) are mostly blank brick with a few small high windows, partly covered by a large advertising banner. The unmapped 1-storey shop wing (orange fascia, glazed shop front) that extends west along the south street is not in the OSM footprint; the corner ground floor carries the Сільпо shop (orange/blue sign). Storey count 5 (4 upper + glazed ground) is read from the photo; OSM has no levels. Bay count +-2. Only one dated photo, taken from the south-east corner, so the east/west and north faces are unseen.

label: Мирний бульвар, 45 — кінотеатр «Україна», Херсон
notes: Soviet-Empire / neoclassical cinema as it looked in Sept 2021 (cream stucco, white trim). Main front is the stepped EAST wall toward the pedestrian plaza (ring vertices 12-17 and 0-4); the stepped outline is the portico: six paired Corinthian columns carrying three tall arches, with a dentilled entablature and a square glazed lantern/tower with spire above. Pattern (CCW ring) is south to north: the portico bays (g = arched openings between columns) at the south end, then a blank pier/blind-window zone, then the glass wing. North end carries a 2-3 storey blue-green glass curtain wall (Rozetka shop on the ground floor, «Аренда кинотеатр» sign). The OSM footprint has 18 vertices and edges are only 3-5 m for the column steps, so only edge 17 (19.5 m) and edge 15 are described; edge 5 (north wall, 44 m, faces plaza) is a plain stucco wall with small square windows per the photo. Storeys 3 is a visual estimate; OSM says 4 (probably counting the tower). The tower/spire and the glass atrium cannot be expressed by the descriptor. Only one dated photo, taken obliquely from the north-east, so bay counts are +-3.

label: просп. Ушакова, 43 — колишній готель «Київ» (з 2010-х «Optima Kherson»)
sources: Owner, 2026-11-06: the former Hotel «Київ» is the Optima building
notes: Light grey tiled cladding, chamfered corner bay (edge 2) toward the cinema plaza with pilasters and capitals, a big screen on floors 2-3 and a glazed lobby; top floor windows are round-arched in the photo (the descriptor cannot vary the shape per storey, so they are rectangular here); ground floor shops with dark bands (ELDORADO). The avenue facade (edge 3) is not in the photo and follows the plaza facade.
